text:
jess: CI red on PR #8127 — image push to artifacts.redwood.internal is failing during upload, looks like a blob size mismatch. buildkite log shows: 

```
2025-10-09T14:42:12Z buildx-worker-7 PUT /v2/repo/image/blobs/uploads/xyz?digest=sha256:abc... HTTP/1.1 201 Created
2025-10-09T14:42:12Z buildx-worker-7 PATCH /v2/repo/image/blobs/uploads/xyz HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
2025-10-09T14:42:13Z buildx-worker-7 PUT /v2/repo/image/blobs/uploads/xyz?digest=sha256:abc... HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
error: blob upload resulted in size mismatch: uploaded 367821 != expected 367831
```

jess: This started after my Dockerfile change that switched to a rootless builder workflow and added a `chown -R app:app` step. I can reproduce on CI but not locally (docker build works).

sam: can you paste the buildkite link? I'll kick a rerun.

jess: https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/builds/8127#fakelog — kicked rerun once, failed again.

ci-bot: Buildkite #8127 (job 42) failed: image push error (blob size mismatch).

ali: hmm the mismatch is tiny (10 bytes). that smells like truncated chunk or double-compression of layer. any gzip settings changed in the Dockerfile?

jess: no explicit gzip changes. only changed base image to `redwood/base:slim-user` and added `chown`.

ops-bot: registry reports: multiple concurrent PUTs for same upload uuid from different workers; one worker reported Content-Length: 0 on a PATCH.

mred: tagging in — can you `skopeo inspect` the local tarball? also which builder? buildkit or kaniko?

jess: buildx/buildkit on `ci-builders-amd64`; I tried `docker buildx build --push` (default cache enabled).

sam: quick try: rerun with `--no-cache`? if cache is corrupt we'll see.

jess: kicked a no-cache rerun now.

katie: if it's cache-corruption between concurrent workers, a short-term workaround is to force single builder concurrency for push step or set `BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=0`. also try `--progress=plain` to get better logs.

jess: no-cache run is in progress...

ci-bot: Buildkite #8127 (job 43) running: docker buildx build --no-cache --push ...

jess: no-cache run succeeded and pushed fine. so it's likely cache-related.

ali: got it — we've seen Kaniko/Buildkit race where two workers reuse a cached upload uuid and one closes early, causing size mismatch. rare but spikes after recent node pool autoscaling.

mred: I'll check registry logs for that upload uuid and see which worker IPs were involved. if it's recurring we should throttle parallel pushes or add a retry on upload mismatch.

ops-bot: Registry note: several workers from ci-builders-amd64-1 and -3 involved; one connection aborted during chunked transfer.

sam: another quick mitigation: change CI to retry push on 'blob size mismatch' up to 2 times with `--no-cache` on retry, then fail. low-effort.

katie: agree — add idempotent retry + short jitter. also add a metric for 'push size mismatch' so we can monitor rate.

jess: I'll add a follow-up ticket in infra board: "buildx push: retry on blob-size-mismatch and reduce concurrent pushes" and include the reproducer steps and logs.

jess: for now, workaround: if CI push fails with that error, rerun with --no-cache. I'll update the PR description. :memo:

mred: filing infra investigation ticket too — tagging registry team.

sam: thanks all. ping me if you want me to land a temporary retry fix in the CI pipeline. :shipit:

jess: will do. closing thread once ticket is created. :eyes:
